records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Our sales are typically higher in our second quarter, which usually includes most of our Anniversary Sale, and in the fourth quarter due to the holidays.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Revenues recognized from our beginning contract liability balance were $119 and $197 the quarter and six months ended July 30, 2022 and $106 and $176 for the quarter and six months ended July 31, 2021.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: We had $465 remaining in share repurchase capacity as of July 30, 2022.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Across both banners, the softening trend was more significant in customer segments with lower income profiles, while we saw greater resilience in customer segments with higher income profiles.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Second quarter net sales increased 12% over the second quarter of 2021, including a benefit of approximately 200 basis points from one week of the Anniversary Sale shifting into the second quarter.
